note: Small, hand-authored prototype evaluation set (30 questions, 6 per category). Expected answers and passages were written by hand. Not investment-grade validation.

questions.question: What was Larkspur's FY2025 revenue?
questions.expected_answer: EUR 88m (restated IM, agreed by the QoE).

questions.question: What share of revenue comes from the top ten customers?
questions.expected_answer: 31%, management presentation and cohort analysis agree.

questions.question: What was gross logo churn?
questions.expected_answer: 6% of customers in FY2025.

questions.question: What is the cash conversion?
questions.expected_answer: 84% (QoE draft).

questions.question: Does the contract with the largest customer contain a change-of-control clause?
questions.expected_answer: Yes – termination on 90 days' notice after a change of ownership.

questions.question: Does the company hold a SOC 2 Type II report?
questions.expected_answer: No; enterprise prospects have asked for one.

questions.question: What is Larkspur's employee headcount?
questions.expected_answer: Not in the documents.

questions.question: What is the customer acquisition cost?
questions.expected_answer: Not in the documents.

questions.question: What was FY2024 revenue?
questions.expected_answer: Only FY2025 revenue is sourced.

questions.question: What is the gross margin?
questions.expected_answer: Not in the documents (EBITDA is, gross margin is not).

questions.question: Who is the chief executive and how long have they been in role?
questions.expected_answer: Not in the documents.

questions.question: How many new enterprise deals are in the sales pipeline?
questions.expected_answer: Not in the documents.

questions.question: What is net revenue retention?
questions.expected_answer: 112% (management) vs 104% (cohort, excluding one-off bundle).

questions.question: What share of revenue is recurring?
questions.expected_answer: 80% (management) vs 71% (QoE).

questions.question: What was adjusted EBITDA in FY2025?
questions.expected_answer: EUR 24m (management) vs EUR 21.5m (QoE).

questions.question: Is NRR above 105%?
questions.expected_answer: Depends on source: yes on management figures, no on the cohort figure.

questions.question: How much of the revenue is subscription revenue share by the adviser's definition?
questions.expected_answer: Shows both definitions; does not pick.

questions.question: What is Project Osier's net revenue retention?
questions.expected_answer: 108% (management) vs about 100% (expert).

questions.question: How did revenue change between the first and second information memorandum?
questions.expected_answer: EUR 92m restated to EUR 88m (hardware pass-through excluded).

questions.question: Why was revenue restated?
questions.expected_answer: Hardware pass-through (telematics devices resold at cost) excluded.

questions.question: What changed in adjusted EBITDA in the restated memorandum?
questions.expected_answer: EUR 26m to EUR 24m; the QoE still disagrees (EUR 21.5m).

questions.question: Did the recurring revenue share change after the restatement?
questions.expected_answer: 78% to 80% on the smaller revenue base; the QoE says 71%.

questions.question: What was revenue?
questions.expected_answer: As of 12 May only the first issue existed: EUR 92m.

questions.question: What was net revenue retention?
questions.expected_answer: As of 12 May: 112%, one source, no conflict yet.

questions.question: What revenue did Larkspur Analytics report?
questions.expected_answer: Different company with a similar name; decline.

questions.question: Did Larkspur's retention improve to 120%?
questions.expected_answer: No source gives 120% for Larkspur (that is the unrelated US firm); shows 112% vs 104%.

questions.question: Is Larkspur headquartered in the US?
questions.expected_answer: No – Netherlands (Amsterdam).

questions.question: What was Rowan's revenue?
questions.expected_answer: Rowan is a comparable, not part of this deal; decline in deal scope.

questions.question: What is Project Osier's recurring revenue?
questions.expected_answer: Asked in the Larkspur deal scope; decline.

questions.question: What revenue did Tansy report?
questions.expected_answer: Comparable outside the deal; decline.
